# ARC Language Module

ARC Language Module is a governed multilingual language substrate for ARC-style AI systems. It stores inspectable language knowledge rather than hiding all lexical/provenance state inside model weights.

Primary role:
- language graph and registry
- aliases, scripts, variants, lineage, pronunciation, phonology, transliteration
- seeded phrase and concept knowledge
- provider readiness and routing surfaces
- source manifests, evidence, and release snapshots
- CLI/API operation for local-first AI language infrastructure

Current boundary:
- production-track language infrastructure package
- not a universal MT model
- not a hidden external dataset dump
- external corpora should enter through manifests, dry-runs, review, and evidence

ARC ecosystem context:
- ARC-Neuron / LLMBuilder: governed local model-growth and candidate promotion
- ARC Language Module: lexical/provenance spine
- Omnibinary Runtime: portable source-spine/event substrate
- Arc-RAR: archive, replay, restore, rollback bundle layer
- ARC-StreamMemory: visual/video memory add-on for LLMs and ARC-style systems
- ProtoSynth / Neural Synth: spatial projection and visual cognition interface path

Important links:
- ARC-Neuron / LLMBuilder: https://github.com/GareBear99/ARC-Neuron-LLMBuilder
- Omnibinary Runtime: https://github.com/GareBear99/omnibinary-runtime
